observations: Single solar panel leaning against a wall.
The panel has a dark frame and a grid of cells.
A watermark 'INNOSON GLOBAL GROUP' is visible across the center.
The photo appears to be taken indoors with artificial lighting.
No brand name, model number, or technical specifications are visible.

claims.evidence: The panel is shown, but its output capacity or suitability for a specific system cannot be confirmed from a single photo.

claims.claim: Battery is new, holds charge for 8 hours. Never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The panel may be a low-quality or counterfeit unit.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's label or specification sticker on the back of the panel.

risks.risk: The panel may be damaged or have degraded cells.
risks.proof: A video showing the panel producing power under direct sunlight.

risks.risk: The seller may be selling a single panel while claiming a complete system.
risks.proof: A photo of the entire solar setup including the inverter and battery.

proof_requests: Photo of the label/sticker on the back of the panel showing the brand and wattage.
Photo of the battery if it is included in the sale.
Video of the panel producing power in direct sunlight.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
